reasoning_summary: Used only the allowed Goodbooks CSVs. I removed missing required book records and all exact raw original_title duplicates, removed every rating row belonging to repeated (user_id, book_id) pairs, joined intent counts on books.id and genre evidence on books.book_id, assigned canonical main genres by summed tag counts with alphabetical tie-breaks, built pandas-style percentile components on the cleaned table, then applied the active-range demand and ratings_count filters and sorted by score descending with book_key ascending for ties.
